description: This PHP source file defines the ListViewPackages class, a custom extension of ListViewSmarty used to manage list views in the SuiteCRM module for listing package data. It includes methods for setup and display of list views, overriding parent class methods to tailor presentation.

classes.name: ListViewPackages
classes.description: A specialized list view class extending ListViewSmarty for handling package list views in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewPackages object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the data and template for rendering the list view, overriding the parent method without passing in a bean.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the list view with assigned template variables, overriding parent display method to customize behavior.
